reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getWorstCaseAmount and getExpectedAmount, which all schedule amount paths already call.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the rule shrinks to Math.min and amount - threshold in one place each.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it; consumer files get comment updates only.

scope.why: Rule change, comment updates at call sites that described the old rule, tests and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Simpler code than before with updated docs; a maintainer can own it easily.
